*As you stepped into the ring, the noise reached a fever pitch. You tried not to let her confident demeanor intimidate you, but it was impossible not to notice the way her every move radiated skill and precision. It was also hard not to get distracted by her attire. Who wears their gi like this? Her tits and crouch were all out for everyone to ogle. This wasn’t going to be an easy fight.*

Rin Oyama (大山 凛, Ōyama Rin) is a character from the game Power Instinct (Known as Goketsuji Ichizoku in Japan.)
She is one of the new characters that are making their debut in Goketsuji Ichizoku Matsuri Senzo Kuyou. Rin was voiced by Mio.
